description: MissionOps | Mars Co-Exploration. We're forming a team for the Martian Map challenge: a NASA-data map where robotic scouts investigate uncertain terrain and help astronauts choose safer, more valuable science targets. I have experience building multi-agent planners and simulation software. Looking for planetary science/GIS, robotics/algorithms, and frontend/3D teammates. We'll develop and validate our challenge-specific solution together during Space Apps.
